title: trigger.deletedependencies
description: Delete all trigger dependencies from the given triggers. The documented parameter type is (string/array) of trigger IDs, but the official example sends an array of trigger objects with the triggerid property; both forms are modeled here.

oneOf.description: ID of the trigger to delete the trigger dependencies from.
IDs of the triggers to delete the trigger dependencies from.
Trigger objects to delete the trigger dependencies from, as used in the official example.

triggerid.description: ID of the trigger to delete the trigger dependencies from.
